qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the orders from the guards and continued to assert that 'We won't do this.' Despite being weary, my resolve held firm until the lights went out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I remained consistent with my earlier defiance.

qa.what_happened: I ordered the prisoners to comply, but they refused and stated 'We won’t do this.' The tension was palpable as they defied all of us, and I had to decide on the next steps.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Pryor, I gave the orders and faced their defiance.

qa.what_happened: During the final hours of Day 6, I refused to comply with the guards' orders during both meal times and the work detail. Despite the escalating threats from the guards, I maintained my stance and refused to give in.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me refusing to comply and standing firm in defiance.

qa.what_happened: Prisoners consistently refused to comply with orders during the day and night, showing clear defiance against the rules of the study. Despite multiple attempts to enforce the rules, they remained steadfast in their refusal.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I had to enforce the rules and maintain order, which often meant ordering the prisoners to comply.

qa.what_happened: Today, we collectively refused to comply with the guards' demands during the work detail and meal times. We also refused to silence ourselves when ordered by Officer Pryor at lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me refusing to comply with the guards' demands.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, despite escalating warnings, the prisoners continued to defy orders. I was determined to maintain control, but the repeated refusals from all three prisoners left me feeling drained.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I am Officer Brooks, and those are my actions as described.
